items.name: !!desc-0
items.text: Set the context. Introduce your idea, your audience and the outcome you want to create.

items.name: !!desc-1
items.text: Explain the challenge. Show why it matters and what needs to change.

items.name: !!desc-2
items.text: Present your approach. Connect the proposed solution to a practical, measurable result.

items.name: !!desc-3
items.text: Bring the story together. Summarize the value and make your next step clear.

items.name: !!section-body
items.text: Replace this text with your introduction. Define the purpose of your presentation in a few concise sentences.

items.name: !!section-body
items.text: Describe the main problem, support it with evidence, and explain its effect on your audience.

items.name: !!section-body
items.text: Outline your approach, the steps involved, and the benefits your audience can expect.

items.name: !!section-body
items.text: Summarize your key message and finish with a clear next step or call to action.
